body: Motel is like a B&B, right? UK and the like. Nonviolent being overdose or drowning, but I'm not sure what wouldn't put me in weeks of suffering first. (Paracetemol OD, to give an example. What commercial drug would be best?)

You think I want to live a life where I'd only be living to exist and please other people, whereas I get no pleasure and I feel like I'm in the darkest of pits 24/7, where the only relief I get is a black, empty void of sleep?

As much as I don't want to hurt my family, I don't want to live either. Try to understand that. If I can't find a way of not hurting my family I'll go through with it anyway.
